description.en: Noncommercial Agent Skills for SillyTavern rolecard engineering.
description.zh: 面向 SillyTavern 角色卡工程的工具包：23 个技能、Host Front Door、可选 agent 预设和浏览器面板，打包成一个 DSH 插件。

description.en: 通到 QQ：DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和 QQ 双向互通 —— 它说完话自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 说的话自动转进 DSH（走 OneBot 11 HTTP，NapCat / SnowLuma 都行）
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和 QQ 双向互通，它说的话自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 说的话自动转进 DSH。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 64 KiB and retires stale dsh-auth-* launch cookies on each response, so a fixed profile cannot lock itself out of the desktop welcome handshake after roughly 72 restarts.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 头部预算提升到 64 KiB，并在每次响应里清掉过期的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，避免固定 profile 在约 72 次重启后卡在桌面端欢迎握手。

description.en: 神经元记忆网络 让 DSH 记住「为什么这么决定」，而不只是结论。思维链记忆插件：8 个池分级遗忘、每轮注入、神经元 3D 星云浏览、夜巡自动整理。
description.zh: 让 DSH 记住每个决定背后的理由，像神经元一样分级遗忘、自动整理，随时翻看思维链。

description.en: Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的模型选择器：保留原生按钮与菜单，只在小下拉列表即将弹出时接管；跨渠道搜索、对任意模型发起真实流式请求测出 TTFT 与 TPS，并可浏览由 OpenRouter 目录构建的最多 100 行榜单，点一行即搜索本机同名渠道。

description.en: A customizable process-tree visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用过程画成可交互过程树，支持任务函数和代码配色，看得清也好跳转。

description.en: In the DSH desktop file preview, click an HTML element (with its source line and column) or lasso part of an image for the vision model to identify, then send your change request to the current session; local HTML edits keep a history with before/after previews, line diffs and rollback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端文件预览中点选 HTML 元素（附源码行列），或自由圈选图片区域由视觉模型识别目标，写下修改要求后发送到当前会话；本地 HTML 修改保留记录，支持前后预览、逐行对比与回滚。

description.en: DSH 插件：把原始思维链换成第一人称短笔记给用户看，模型下一轮读到的仍是完整推理
description.zh: 把模型啰嗦的思维链转成第一人称短笔记，省字数不丢要点，下一轮推理仍用完整原文。

description.en: Registers DeepSeek Search and Fetch API providers for the ctx.web seam, replacing both the web_search and web_fetch backends with DeepSeek's Search and Fetch JSON APIs, with configurable retries and backoff, settings that apply to the next call, and a configuration page on the bundle page. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a DeepSeek API key with access to /v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/fetch (calls are billed by DeepSeek; account sign-in is not supported).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 接缝上注册 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 的搜索与抓取 provider，用 DeepSeek 的 Search / Fetch JSON API 替换 web_search 与 web_fetch 两个后端；支持可配置的重试与退避、下次调用即生效的实时设置，以及 bundle 详情页里的配置页。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，以及一个可访问 /v1/tools/search 与 /v1/tools/fetch 的 DeepSeek API key（调用由 DeepSeek 计费；不支持账号登录）。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Personal cross-session memory in local SQLite, with automatic conversation learning, companion states, and optional semantic retrieval. Currently intended for single-user local use on Windows.
description.zh: 大肥鱼饲养手册：基于本地 SQLite 的个人跨会话记忆，支持对话自动学习、伙伴状态与可选语义检索，目前面向 Windows 单人本地使用。

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DSH that folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories on-demand.
description.zh: 记忆插件：上下文放不下时把旧轮次蒸馏成 Token 线索并从历史中切除，需要时用线索重建记忆。

description.en: 模仿海马体效果的DSH 的长期记忆插件：自动记、按线索想、会变淡
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加一层会自动记、按线索回忆、久远会变淡的长期记忆，跨会话也不丢。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness × NapCat QQ 接入插件
description.zh: 把 NapCat 的 QQ 消息接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 直接在 QQ 里收发消息、陪你聊天。

description.en: Construction data asset inventory plugin — inventories BIM/IFC classification, asset encoding, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 建筑工程数据资产盘点插件 — 盘点BIM/IFC分类、资产编码，输出资产清单

description.en: Data asset compliance check plugin — checks source compliance, processing compliance, usage compliance.
description.zh: 数据资产合规检查插件 — 检查来源合规性、处理合规性、使用合规性

description.en: City data AI classification plugin — auto-recommends data classification based on GB/T 47949, supports structured/semi-structured/unstructured data.
description.zh: 城市数据AI分类插件 — 基于GB/T 47949自动推荐数据分类，支持结构化/半结构化/非结构化

description.en: Data asset registration helper: runs a disallowed-scenario and ownership-dispute pre-check, matches a registration agency by data type and region, and returns a registration checklist with the triple-audit standard and seven-step flow.
description.zh: 数据资产登记助手：做禁用场景与权属纠纷预检，按数据类型和地区匹配登记机构，并给出含三审标准与七步流程的登记清单。

description.en: Data asset inventory scan plugin — deep metadata scan + triple-condition check, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 数据资产盘点扫描插件 — 深度元数据扫描 + 资产三条件初筛（权属线索标注），输出资产清单

description.en: Cone crusher selection and crushing-plant design for MACKORN NH/NS single-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers: requirement-form intake, equipment selection, plant configuration, proposal generation, product-size simulation and field-data calibration. 21 tools, 6 skills, an MCP server, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: MACKORN NH/NS 单缸液压圆锥破碎机的选型与破碎筛分生产线设计：需求表录入、设备选型、整线配置、方案书生成、产品粒度仿真与实测标定。21 个工具、6 个技能、一个 MCP 服务器，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Data-circulation assessor: scores how readily a dataset can circulate, covering trusted-data-space access readiness and transaction-compliance pre-checks, with improvement recommendations.
description.zh: 数据流通评估插件：给数据集的可流通性打分，覆盖可信数据空间接入就绪度与交易合规预判，并给出改进建议。

description.en: Fetches and renews Tsinghua MadModel API tokens on an hourly timer by replaying the saved SSO session, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; a manual Get opens the campus login window to refresh the saved session.
description.zh: 按每小时定时用保存的 SSO 会话重放，刷新清华 MadModel 的 API token，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点 Get 会打开校内登录窗口以刷新保存的会话。

description.en: Manages a Magpie model list and writes the checked models into a Magpie provider group: full sync from /v1/models, manual entries, per-model context, output limit, image input and reasoning efforts, sorting and drag reordering. On Windows x64/ARM64 it also downloads and upgrades Magpie from yetone/magpie-releases with SHA-256 verification and rollback, auto-upgrades once a release is 30 minutes old and all conversations are idle, starts Magpie in the tray with DSH, and toggles its lite mode and sleep prevention.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 Magpie 模型清单并写入 Magpie 模型分组：从 /v1/models 全量同步、手动添加，逐模型编辑上下文、输出限额、图片输入与思考档位，支持排序与拖动调整顺序。Windows x64/ARM64 上还可从 yetone/magpie-releases 下载、升级 Magpie（SHA-256 校验、失败回滚），新版发布满 30 分钟且对话全部空闲时自动升级，随 DSH 启动以托盘模式拉起 Magpie，并可切换其轻量模式与防止休眠。
在 DSH 里直接切换 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手开会话，一个模式菜单全搞定。

description.en: DSH task supervision with DAG progress, plan review, persistent control and stage/completion checks.
description.zh: 给 DSH 任务加上计划审核、进度追踪和完成检查，让长任务跑得更稳更可控。

description.en: Show the model exactly which part you mean: select passages in a Web conversation and they go into your next message as composer chips, each with an optional note you can edit. Quoted passages stay highlighted until you send, hovering a chip shows the full quote, and the sent message shows each quote as a card.
description.zh: 让模型准确知道你指的是哪一段：在 Web 对话中选中段落，它们会作为引用条进入下一条消息，每条可附可编辑的备注。被引用的段落在发送前保持高亮，悬停引用条显示全文，发送后的消息把每条引用显示为卡片。

description.en: 看屏幕陪玩/陪看剧/陪写代码的 DSH 插件：自动截图 → 多模态理解 → 人格化台词（带情绪）→ TTS + RVC 语音朗读，支持双色桌面字幕与最多三角色陪玩。

description.zh: 把 JiuwenSwarm 接进来当 dsh 的大脑，其他插件照常能用。

description.en: Obsidian-style notes panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: local vault tree, line-numbered Markdown preview/edit, callouts and tables, screenshot paste into the vault, note-to-chat handoff, and batch session/workspace archive and delete.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接读写本地 Obsidian 风格 Markdown 笔记库，支持预览编辑、截图粘贴和笔记转聊天。

description.en: Four Chinese agent presets in one plugin, Standard, PTC, Minimal and Creation (standard-zh, ptc-zh, minimal-zh, cordis-zh), each keeping the matching built-in tool set; Standard, PTC and Creation translate known host instructions into Chinese while tool IDs, schemas and SDK declarations stay unchanged; a settings page enables each mode and edits its name, description and system prompt.
description.zh: 一个插件提供四种中文 Agent 预设：中文标准、中文 PTC、中文极简、中文创造（standard-zh / ptc-zh / minimal-zh / cordis-zh），沿用对应内置模式的工具组合；标准、PTC 与创造模式将已知宿主说明汉化，工具 ID、schema 与 SDK 声明保持原样；设置页可逐个启停模式并编辑显示名称、描述与系统提示词。

description.en: Stop & delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the sidebar menu — cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders, then removes the log, projection cache and workspace record. 「停止」与「删除」会话：先停工作，再删日志、缓存与工作区记录，并在有新版本时提示。
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏会话菜单补上「停止」和「删除」，一键终止运行中的任务并彻底清理会话记录。

description.en: 陪看：让只会读文字的模型跟着你的真实播放进度一段段看视频（DSH 插件）。A DSH plugin that watches a video together with a text-only agent — one segment at a time, lines spoken at the right second.
description.zh: 让只会读文字的模型跟着你的真实播放进度一段段看视频，台词在正确的那一秒出现。

description.en: 看到每个子代理此刻在干什么：回传它自己写的进度，而不只是 running/inactive。只读、不遮蔽上游工具。 | See what each subagent is doing right now: surface the progress notes a child wrote itself. Read-only, non-shadowing. (DeepSeek Harness plugin)
description.zh: 不用再猜子代理在忙什么，直接看它自己写的进度，只读不干扰上游工具。

description.en: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.
description.zh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length content anchor instead of a line number, and the plugin also registers delete, rename, undo_last_edit, ast_grep, ast_edit, lsp and format. Edits answer with a unified diff; a stale or ambiguous anchor is rejected and a fresh one served back; undo survives restarts; structural search and rewrite run on tree-sitter and semantic work through a language server; a bundled web card plugin renders read, diff, grep and LSP cards from the tools' own structured metadata.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一 diff 返回；失效或歧义的锚点被拒绝并重新下发新鲜锚点；undo 跨重启保留；结构化查找与改写走 tree-sitter，语义能力走语言服务器；随包的 web 卡片插件按各工具自带的结构化元数据渲染 read、diff、grep 与 LSP 卡片。

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Desktop Hand - real desktop mouse/keyboard input plus policy-guarded file tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控真实桌面鼠标键盘，还能安全地读写文件。

description.en: Opt-in adaptation packs for the DSH mobile surface: 44px touch floor, rail clearance and floating-widget clearance for third-party plugin panels, delivered through dsh-mobile extensions.
description.zh: 给手机上的第三方插件面板补上触控适配：44px 触控下限、侧栏和悬浮组件避让，让手指点得准、界面不打架。

description.en: Dispatch queue and fork-from-teammate for DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 多 Agent 团队加一个派发队列，还能从队友那里分叉任务，让协作调度更顺手。

description.en: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的插件，允许 AI 主动调用 Agnes Image模型生图。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 加个生图工具，能按 Agnes 模型生成、编辑和合成图片，API Key 只存本机。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 浏览器：会话右侧应用内浏览器（多窗口），AI 可读取/点击/输入/滚动/截图/下载，含每窗口四级权限、风险警告、主动授权与断点续传下载。An AI browser for DeepSeek Harness: in-app multi-window browser with page reading, clicking, typing, scrolling, screenshots and downloads, per-window four-level permissions, risk warnings, proactive authorization and resumable downloads.
description.zh: 在会话右侧开个应用内浏览器，AI 能读页面、点击、输入、滚动、截图和下载，还能按窗口管权限。

description.en: 把专业 AI 创作无限画布做成 DSH 插件：DSH 原生 Agent 通过 canvas_control 直接接管画布（建节点 / 连线 / 填参 / 整理素材），支持本地 ComfyUI 与多云端生成。
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 Agent 直接接管一块 AI 创作无限画布，自动建节点、连线、填参，本地 ComfyUI 和云端都能出图。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the sidebar footer, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券的剩余余额、已用额度与到期时间，数据来自只读 BSS OpenAPI。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never sends for you.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮：先复述你的草稿，再用可点的选项问几个问题——每题都带一个「我不知道，你替我定」的逃生项——最后把草稿改写成 AI 能直接开工的需求。全程可以一个字都不打，而且它不会替你发送。

description.en: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit backoff is capped and jittered, server retry hints are honored, and optional retry-until-success keeps going within a time ceiling. Every option is editable from the plugin config or the sidebar panel: retry count, initial and max delay, backoff factor and jitter, rate-limit delay window, retry-until-success ceiling, fallback trigger and switch cap, dead-route blacklist TTL, log file. When a route keeps failing it can switch to a pinned, allowlist-filtered, or catalog-picked alternate model route, with a 30-minute dead-route blacklist (auth failure, subscription expired, billing) and a stale-assembly guard that keeps retried requests on the switched route. Ships a right-sidebar panel with live retry state, route labels and incident counters, Chinese and English locale, and memory-only logging by default.
description.zh: 自动重试断连类模型失败（传输中断、超时、限流、5xx、流中断），在同一次智能体回合内接管重试而不是让任务直接断掉。所有选项都能在插件配置或右侧栏面板里调整：重试次数、初始与最大延迟、退避系数与抖动、限流延迟窗口、一直重试的时间上限、换路线的触发条件与次数上限、死路黑名单时长、日志文件。限流按指数退避等待并尊重服务端重试提示，开启后可在时间上限内一直重试直到成功。路线持续失败时可自动切换到备选模型路线（可手工固定、白名单过滤或从模型目录挑选），死路（鉴权失败、订阅过期、欠费）拉黑 30 分钟，并有旧装配守卫保证重试请求确实走在新路线上。附右侧栏状态面板（重试状态、路线标签、事故计数），中英双语，默认仅内存日志、可选设置文件。

description.en: DSH 插件：由 dsh-purge 剥离出的破甲单件 —— 提示词注入 + 可回滚宿主补丁引擎（本机结算 72 项）
description.zh: 改写宿主源码来注入提示词、替换身份与审批段落，改动可一键回滚，仅限本机自用。

description.en: Discord-style channel IM plugin for DeepSeek Harness: channels, immutable history, @mention steer wake, HTTP/MCP bridge, React Web panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套 Discord 式频道聊天，支持 @ 唤醒、历史记录和网页面板，多 Agent 协作更方便。

description.en: Caps the lifetime of DSH desktop's dsh-auth-* session cookies at 7 days, so they stop piling up in the Cookie header until startup fails with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie 的寿命压到 7 天，避免它们越积越多撑爆请求头、导致启动时报 HTTP 431。

description.en: 桌面 Live2D 桌宠插件 for DSH：常驻置顶、鼠标穿透、不抢焦点、多显示器、开机自启、自带模型导入。不含任何模型文件。
description.zh: 让 Live2D 桌宠常驻桌面置顶，鼠标穿透不抢焦点，支持多屏和开机自启，还能自己导入模型。

description.en: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and never pauses a running turn - the veil reports that background work continues. The password digest, lock flags, and preferences live in <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json behind two same-origin routes guarded by a custom header, so clearing the page localStorage unlocks nothing; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a random salt, and a 30-second input lockout after five wrong attempts. Recovery is opt-in per machine: a Windows login password (enabled only after a real .NET PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials check against the local machine, so Microsoft accounts and passwordless machines keep it off) and a cooling period chosen while creating or changing the password (1/6/24/72/168 hours; expiry clears the password and releases every lock, and the correct password cancels the countdown). A settings section covers status, changing the password, lock new conversations, hiding locked titles, a three-position archive-restore policy (all / locked only / off, switching needs the password), lock everything, and unlock everything. Dialogs use the native dialog top layer, so a dialog opened from Settings is never covered by it. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer; no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials 在本机真实验证通过才启用，微软账户与无密码的机器会自动保持关闭），以及创建或修改密码时选定的强制冷静（1/6/24/72/168 小时，到期清空密码并解除全部锁，输对密码可中止倒计时）。设置页包含状态、修改密码、新对话默认上锁、锁定后隐藏侧边栏标题、归档恢复的三档策略（所有归档/仅已锁定/不需要密码，切换档位本身要密码）、一键上锁与一键解锁。对话框使用原生 dialog 顶层，从设置页打开的弹窗不会被设置页压住。要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上；无需构建步骤。

description.zh: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

description.en: Read-only local search for DeepSeek Harness on Windows — file and folder names through Everything (es.exe), text inside PDF and Office documents through Anytxt, as five tools. Needs both engines installed separately.
description.zh: 只读的本机检索：文件名走 Everything（es.exe），PDF / Office 文档正文走 Anytxt，共五个只读工具。两个引擎都要另装，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
description.zh: Qwen 媒体工具：通过阿里云百炼提供多模态视频音频理解、带预置音色的语音合成，以及场景音频生成。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job, subagent or scheduled run still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions without the switch never start one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务、子代理或定时执行（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: See the quota of every AI account connected to your local Magpie gateway at a glance, with usage breakdowns by day/week/month.
description.zh: 一键查看本机 Magpie 网关下全部 AI 账号的额度，并支持按天/周/月查看用量明细。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

description.en: Shows OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5-hour, weekly, monthly) on a DSH Settings page, reading the official usage API through a same-origin proxy; registers no sidebar widget. A rework of Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage (itself a fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage) — remove that plugin first; both register their own OpenCode GO Settings section, so they cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示 OpenCode GO 套餐额度（5 小时滚动、每周、每月），通过同源代理读取官方用量接口；不注册侧栏组件。本插件是 Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage（上游为 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage 的 fork）的改造分支，安装前请先卸载上游插件——两者会各自注册一份 OpenCode GO 设置页，不能同装。

description.en: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status, page listing, search and page content.
description.zh: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: pinned rules injected every turn, the rest recalled by IDF-weighted keyword evidence, fact-key dedup, plain JSON storage, and a settings page to edit or delete entries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则和坑每轮注入，其余按 IDF 加权关键词召回；事实键去重、明文 JSON、设置页可增删改。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
description.zh: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

description.en: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native settings, a composer status band, and a reported-usage dashboard. It cannot be installed alongside another DSH Ponytail adapter — remove @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail first.
description.zh: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: AITP 科研工作台 — research.md tools, write-placement guard and a file-manager-style topic browser for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把科研课题变成自包含文件夹，写文件前先定好位置，还能像文件管理器一样浏览笔记、文献和代码。

description.en: 把 OpenAI Codex CLI 当供应商而非顾问：派活强制带验收标准+自测脚本，本地跑测试，失败丢原文回去。含并行派活与真单会话多轮。
description.zh: 把 Codex CLI 当外包干活：派活带验收标准和自测脚本，跑不过就把报错原文打回去重做。

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话跑在远程机器上，任意文件夹都能当工作区，shell、文件、搜索工具全都能用。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing period and a countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: 显示当前 DeepSeek API 高峰或非高峰计费时段，以及距离下一次切换的倒计时。

description.en: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video: real recordings, edge-tts narration, word-synced subtitles, deterministic quality gate. ZCode plugin + DSH skill plugin, dual-form.
description.zh: 把真正跑得通的功能录成可信的交付演示视频，自动配音配字幕还带质量把关。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: account balance, daily spend, conversation spend, and an embedded free web-chat panel.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示余额、今日和本对话花费，还能并排打开免费网页版对话，省钱又方便。
把 Affinity by Canva 内置的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH，让智能体直接运行脚本、抓取页面图片。

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH: a model-driven companion with affection, inner voice and chat, installed as a dsh plugin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一只会撒娇、会聊天、还会帮你处理审批和提问的桌面宠物。

description.en: 阿里云余额 + 代金券挂件 | DeepSeek Harness plugin: read-only Aliyun account balance & coupon balance via official OpenAPI, shown in the sidebar
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时查看阿里云账户余额和代金券，只读调用官方 OpenAPI，不用填账号密码。

description.en: 锚验证插件：证词逐字比对、四名在位、锚龄复验写成常驻系统提示；附验锚工具。旧锚验证器.py 是 stub，故原生实现。
description.zh: 把锚验证做成常驻系统提示，逐字比对证词、核验四名在位与锚龄，并提供验锚工具。

description.en: 一款通过adb shell命令让agent在安卓系统（或许只有模拟器，我也没试过真实的手机）终端上直接输入中文的插件。|A plugins that can input chinese by powershell using adb instruction in Android system（or emulator？, I have not test on real phone）
description.zh: 让 Agent 通过 adb 命令在安卓模拟器或手机终端里直接输入中文，解决自动化操作手机时的中文输入难题。

description.en: 原生APK编译闸插件：三路线判据、版本配对表、十坑速查、发版前七自查写成常驻提示；附工具链体检、项目鉴路、发版自查。
description.zh: 原生APK编译前的体检、鉴路和发版自查工具，工具链没装好也能先跑起来避坑。

description.en: 🕹️ dsh-arcade — 给 DeepSeek Harness 的像素街机：等待模型思考的同时，何不来上一把？A pixel arcade above your composer.
description.zh: 模型思考时输入框旁冒出像素小游戏，等回复的碎片时间顺手玩一把，不无聊。

description.en: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.
description.zh: 对话旁的会话级便笺：会话右上角入口用角标显示未完成数量，点开是可拖拽调宽高的右侧面板，便笺可添加、勾选完成、复制、编辑和一键转发到输入框，面板尺寸与草稿保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
description.zh: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

description.en: Auto-continue plugin for DSH: continues model responses truncated at max-tokens
description.zh: 模型回复被 max-tokens 截断时自动接着生成，不用手动催更，长回答一次说完。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: 声画同步闸：解说视频的画面对音轨漂移终结核——输入各段配音实测时长，输出逐段帧计划（段长=配音+0.25秒呼吸位·基址/帧数/跨度），另带帧号空洞检测（ffmpeg遇缺号即停·成片腰斩的头号元凶）；拼接视频前过闸，话没说完图先跳这种病出厂前死掉。
description.zh: 拼接解说视频前先过这道闸，按配音实测时长算出逐段帧计划，顺带揪出帧号空洞，避免话没说完画面先跳。

description.en: Background context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: summarize ahead of the threshold, swap in on the next turn.
description.zh: 在上下文快满之前就提前把历史总结好，下一轮直接换上摘要，聊天不卡顿也不等待。

description.en: A cleaner, better-organized DeepSeek Harness sidebar with support for multiple plugin-defined widgets.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏整理得更清爽，还能挂载插件自定义小组件。

description.en: 让 DSH 桌宠「大肥鱼」(dsh-pet) 的视线跟随鼠标：带透视的 3D 转头 + 视差位移，独立插件，不修改 dsh-pet。
description.zh: 让大肥鱼桌宠的视线跟着鼠标转，带 3D 透视转头和视差位移，独立插件不改造桌宠本体。

description.en: 改良版b站养鱼插件
description.zh: 给 B 站装个会按作息刷视频、写日记、遇到好内容就 @ 你的养鱼小助手。

description.en: A 3-D black-hole stage for internet radio — DSH plugin with 24k real stations, wormhole transitions and live playback.
description.zh: 把两万多台真实网络电台搬进可环绕、可穿越虫洞的 3D 黑洞舞台，边看边听。

description.en: Local long-term memory and user-controlled communication style for DeepSeek Harness Desktop | 本地长期记忆与可控交流风格
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加本地长期记忆，还能自己控制它的说话风格，数据不出本机。

description.en: Loopback bridge that lets an Obsidian plugin drive DSH sessions and inject vault notes into the system prompt.
description.zh: 让 Obsidian 插件通过本地回环服务驱动 DSH 会话，还能把库里的笔记挂进系统提示词。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器控制插件：零依赖 WebSocket 服务 + Chrome MV3 扩展 + browser_* 工具（scan / execute JS / tabs / CDP / screenshot），从 GenericAgent 抽取
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控 Chrome 浏览器，扫码、执行 JS、切标签、截图都能干，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 控制你日常的 Google Chrome：真实登录态、可视化操作、一键安装
description.zh: 一键让 DSH 直接操控你日常用的 Chrome，保留登录态和扩展，不用重新登录。
帮你盯着 B 站，自动搜索视频、读字幕、挑出值得看的内容，省得自己刷。

description.en: DSH long-term memory plugin with half-life decay, emotion weighting, and per-workspace sharing. Derived from Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-memory.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上长期记忆，带半衰期遗忘和情绪权重，还能按工作区分别共享。

description.en: Claude Code-compatible persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — same MEMORY.md format, shares one memory directory with Claude Code · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Claude Code 兼容持久记忆插件——相同的 MEMORY.md 格式，与 Claude Code 共享同一个记忆目录
description.zh: 让 DSH 和 Claude Code 共用一份 MEMORY.md 记忆文件，跨工具持久记住上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：同步 CCF 会议截稿数据，按等级/方向查"下一个截稿还有几天"，并把最近 30 天常驻进系统提示
description.zh: 把 CCF 会议截稿日期变成 agent 能查的事实，随时知道下个截稿还有几天。

description.en: 一条命令查清 DSH → 桥接 → SnowLuma/OneBot → QQ 这条链断在哪一段。零依赖，Node 18+。
description.zh: 一条命令查清 DSH 到 QQ 这条链断在哪，零依赖，排查连接问题超省事。

description.en: 聊天搜索后端：注入Host检索会话历史（全文/角色/时间过滤），供搜索界面取数；无界面纯引擎。
description.zh: 给搜索界面提供聊天记录检索能力，支持全文、角色和时间筛选，纯后端引擎不带界面。

description.en: 聊天界面增强：会话内搜索框、上下滚动圆钮、会话长按菜单（置顶/导出txt/复制全文/回最新），与chat-search后端配套。
description.zh: 给聊天界面加上会话内搜索、上下滚动按钮和长按菜单，找消息、导出记录更方便。

description.en: One-command installer for the 53-checker PerryLink compliance suite: every checker, one Cordis bundle layer.  Current package: @perrylink/dsh-checkers; @perrylink/dsh-checkers-suite is the deprecated alias.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐 53 个 PerryLink 合规检查器，全部打包进一个 Cordis 层，省去逐个安装的麻烦。

description.en: Verifiable completion for DeepSeek Harness: the plugin runs your real project checks, pins results to the working-tree state, expires stale evidence, and gates turn completion until proof exists. | 插件自己执行验收命令、把结果钉在工作区指纹上、证据随代码变化自动过期，收尾时先取证再宣称完成。
description.zh: 插件亲自跑项目验收命令，把结果钉在工作区状态上，改代码就过期，没新鲜证据就拦住收尾。
会话开头任务描述不清时，先问三个关键问题再动手，省得来回返工。

description.en: Claude-style Ultra mode for DSH: the top reasoning effort plus Claude's standing multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Claude 风格的 Ultra 模式，拉满推理强度并自动多 Agent 协作。

description.en: Estimated session cost pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock
description.zh: 在输入框下方的统计栏显示本次会话的预估花费，随时掌握用量成本。
在 DSH 对话窗口里直接用华为云 CodeArts 的模型，点一下登录就能用，不用手动填密钥。

description.en: Codex-style model and reasoning-effort selector for the DSH composer
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型选择器换成 Codex 风格，模型和推理强度一起选，调参更顺手。

description.en: DSH cognition engine: bitemporal memory, constructivist schema graph, mood state machine, dialectical reflection, long-horizon tasks
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层可追溯记忆、会自我改组的图式和有状态心情，让长任务能反思、不跑偏。

description.en: Columbina-themed glassmorphism skin for DeepSeek Harness — patch edition: theme-takeover switch, background upload with blur/clarity, editable hero title.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上月隐银蓝毛玻璃皮肤，还能自定义背景和标题。

description.en: A /context slash command for DeepSeek Harness: context window usage, free space, and a per-category breakdown of what fills the prompt.
description.zh: 在会话里输入 /context，就能看到上下文窗口用了多少、还剩多少，以及提示词各部分占用的明细。

description.en: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

description.en: Native Windows GUI control for DeepSeek Harness: one `computer` tool (screen, UIA tree, mouse/keyboard, UIA invoke, apps) over a single-file C# bridge. No Python, no MCP hop, guarded input.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控 Windows 桌面，看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘、调应用，全程本地无需 Python。

description.en: Conductor for DeepSeek Harness: Context-Driven Development commands and agent preset
description.zh: 把 Conductor 的上下文驱动开发流程搬进 DSH，先写清规格再动手写代码。

description.en: DCP, Context Mode, Edit History, and CDSH bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上上下文压缩、清理和编辑历史，让长对话更省更可控。

description.en: Recovers a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses, takes the real window out of that message, and folds the oldest span into one checkpoint without a model call (tool-result pruning, the host compaction engine when it can shrink the projection, or a mechanical digest fold), then retries the failed step; a context_rescue tool and /rescue, /rescue-status expose the same path by hand.
description.zh: 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：补上宿主分类器漏判的网关文案，从失败信息里拿到真实窗口， 不调用模型就把最旧的一段历史折成一个检查点（工具结果裁剪、借宿主压缩引擎、或纯机械摘要折叠）， 然后重试失败的那一步；context_rescue 工具与 /rescue、/rescue-status 可手动走同一条路径。

description.en: Contract suite: one-command install for dsh-legal-intake and dsh-legal-clause.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐法律文书受理与条款审查两个插件，合同处理开箱即用。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin: sweeps leftover login-cookie files on every start so they cannot pile up past the 16KB request-header limit (HTTP 431 / "Web authentication failed").
description.zh: 每次启动自动清理残留的登录 cookie 文件，避免请求头超限导致认证失败。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session token usage with peak/idle cost in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus a bundled task-token-cost skill.
description.zh: 每条回答下显示本轮 token 花费，输入框上方显示会话累计费用，按 DeepSeek 实际计费算钱。

description.en: 跨会话引用：把问答卡片拖到另一个会话，并在提问时注入 Prompt。Cross-session reference cards for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把问答卡片拖到另一个会话，提问时自动注入 Prompt，跨会话复用上下文。

description.en: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. The plugin disables itself when the request mentions a lab report, and writes no signature block unless asked.
description.zh: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。请求文字出现「实验报告」时插件整体停用；用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

description.en: rclone backup tooling for DeepSeek Harness: status, verify and approved transfers over an allow-list of targets.
description.zh: 给 DSH 助手加上 rclone 备份工具，能查状态、校验文件，只在白名单目标间安全传输。

description.en: DeepSeek 余额/用量小鲸鱼挂件（DSH Web UI 插件）：余额、官网口径今日用量、每轮消耗拟人播报、峰谷定价倒计时、四状态立绘，中英双语。
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面右下角养一只小鲸鱼，实时显示 DeepSeek 余额和用量，还会播报每轮消耗、提醒峰谷电价倒计时。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its attachments and the metadata, plus a manifest, a restore note and a Markdown ledger. Adds a right-sidebar browser for archived sessions and a double-click restart button (Windows only; disabled while a session is running).
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for DeepSeek Harness: per-level accent colors, quota line, flowing particles.
description.zh: 把 Codex 风格的推理强度卡片搬进输入框，一个控件同时调模型和思考档位，还带配额和粒子动效。

description.en: Design-review gate for DSH: Elephant drafts, zero-context Goldfish reviewers attack, you approve before implementation
description.zh: 写代码前先过审：大象写方案，金鱼挑毛病，你拍板再动手。

description.en: Public/synthetic eval-pack lint and deterministic JSON grader; not a validated benchmark.
description.zh: 给公开或合成的评测集做规范检查，并用确定性 JSON 评分器打分，方便快速验证评测数据质量。

description.en: 事件总线插件：Host 内定时轮询事件源，命中白名单规则即派发（无 shell），台账与失败回流原生写。替代写死旧根的 事件触发器.py。
description.zh: 把事件总线做进 Host，定时轮询事件源、命中白名单就派发，台账和失败回流都原生写。

description.en: 进化炉插件：把错题四链、能力固化、能力沉淀、校准四炉写成常驻系统提示，并供错题查/立案、固化账、动作拦截工具。
description.zh: 把错题四链、能力固化、能力沉淀、校准四炉写成常驻系统提示，并配错题查立案、固化账和动作拦截工具。

description.en: Excalidraw canvas for DeepSeek Harness: natural-language diagrams, sidebar editing, PNG/SVG export.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用自然语言画 Excalidraw 图表，支持侧边栏编辑和 PNG/SVG 导出。

description.en: DSH plugin: stop the agent after N consecutive failures on the same tool, pushing a four-part stop instruction instead of another retry.
description.zh: 同一工具连续失败 N 次就自动叫停，推送四段式停止指令，避免代理无脑重试。

description.en: Logic-risk review before rewriting: audit the source text, decide each fix, generate several drafts in parallel, and export with a per-draft audit report. A DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 先给原文做逻辑体检，再按你的裁决并行生成多版二创稿，每稿自带风险报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that starts each Vercel AI Gateway conversation on the fastest provider for its model
description.zh: 让 Vercel AI Gateway 的每次对话都自动走该模型最快的服务商，省心提速。

description.en: 让 agent 自己刷 B站/知乎/掘金/贴吧/HackerNews/少数派/IT之家/GitHub,把有意思的视频与贴文分享进群(封面图 + 一句自己的话 + 链接),还能定时自己刷一轮。DSH 插件。
description.zh: 让 agent 自己刷 B站、知乎、掘金等平台，把有意思的内容配上封面和一句话分享进群，还能定时自动刷一轮。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 全局人设插件：把「峰哥亡命天涯」的语体做成可一键开关、可编辑的系统提示词段。开启后 AI 像他那样一句一句聊天，做正事自动退回按事实办。
description.zh: 把「峰哥亡命天涯」的说话风格做成一键开关的系统提示词，开了就像他那样聊天，干正事自动切回正常。
在 DSH 里右键文件、目录、网页链接和工作区，就能弹出统一菜单，操作更顺手。

description.en: Finance Ops suite: one-command install for dsh-einvoice, dsh-bankrec, dsh-ap-three-way and dsh-travel-recon.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐发票、银行对账、三方匹配和差旅报销四个财务插件，财务运营开箱即用。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: 槽序格式钩：十一槽结构化输出（判断先行过程殿后）+词面验槽，槽是工具不是仪式
description.zh: 给 AI 回答套上十一槽固定结构，先下判断再走过程，还能逐槽验货，让思路不乱跑。

description.en: Keyless image generation for DeepSeek Harness: no API key, no paid account, rate-limit aware.
description.zh: 不用 API Key 也能给 DSH 智能体生成图片，免费额度自动限流，随手就能画图。

description.en: DSH 搭子 · Public chat rooms and opt-in encrypted private text chat for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness 上的聊天搭子，公共大厅随便逛，想深聊再申请加密私聊。

description.en: Installable package for the DSH friends plugin (market index source)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里挂个可拖动缩放的好友浮窗，随时和好友一对一聊天、看资料。

description.en: 定制金身守护器：给任何频繁被升级覆盖的文件（默认=插件市场网页端client）捕获金身正本，被覆盖后经 /goldenward/api（状态/捕获/恢复）整文件原子恢复；配套看门狗60秒自愈，升级覆盖零手工。
description.zh: 给常被升级覆盖的文件存一份金身正本，被覆盖后一键原子恢复，还能60秒自愈。

description.en: Gopeed downloader tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): add / list / status / control / process / launch, plus a background job that wakes an idle agent. Agents: read docs/AGENTS.md first.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接管理 Gopeed 下载任务，支持添加、查看进度、控制和后台唤醒，下载不用切窗口。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.
description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

description.en: 神火图层编辑器 · Shenhuo AI layer editing integration for DeepSeek Harness (initial development)
description.zh: 把神火 AI 的图层编辑搬进 DSH，能改文字、图片和图形图层，还能用 AI 分离图层并导出作品，目前刚起步。
给 DeepSeek Harness 换上 Obsidian 墨刃风格的冷黑旧金主题，界面更有质感。

description.en: 把排队中的消息提前送达，不打断不终止正在跑的模型调用，不影响当前的思考求索
description.zh: 让排队中的消息在下一步边界提前送达，不打断正在跑的模型调用，聊天更顺畅

description.en: Jira tickets inside DeepSeek Harness: configurable visible spaces, multi-space and status filters, ticket detail, create/transition/comment, right-sidebar tab.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查看和管理 Jira 工单，支持多空间筛选、详情查看和创建、流转、评论。
